$comment: Approved music catalog for the PLATFORM orchestrator path (the trackb-orchestrator server function + trackb-render). The Product Editor's music picker and the render stage only accept tracks that appear in a project's frozen_audio, and the orchestrator freezes exactly the tracks listed here. The durable public MP3 URLs are minted ONCE via the platform's elevenlabs-audio integration (AI-generated, workspace-licensed — cleared for Track B renders, never sourced from the open web) and stored in the trackb_config row with config_key 'music_catalog'; this file is the module-side manifest of that catalog. For the file-based CLI pipeline, drop the same tracks here as <id>.mp3 next to this manifest.
storage: trackb_config key 'music_catalog' holds { tracks: [{ id, label, url, preset, duration_ms, license, created_at }] }
minted_by: trackb-orchestrator ensureMusicCatalog() — one-time, on the first app tick that carries a workspace session token

tracks.label: Tech Pulse
tracks.source: elevenlabs-audio integration, preset 'tech' (electronic ambient, futuristic synths), 60s loop
tracks.license: AI-generated via the platform's ElevenLabs integration — workspace-licensed, cleared for Track B renders
